note: City of Auburn RV park at the Auburn Recreation Complex (419 Q St), a loop of gravel pads in the trees beside the ball fields and trail, above a wooded creek. Booked online through the city's park-reservation system after reading its liability waiver. Restrooms with drinking water, and a dump station. --Claude
summary: City page confirms $20.00 a night, April 1 - October 31 (weather permitting), 10-night limit, online reservations through the city's go2gov system (parks.go2gov.net, 'RV Parking Fee'), dump station, potable water at the restrooms, phone (402) 274-3420 (matches). Fees/facilities/season/booking upgraded to manual. Site count and hookups not stated anywhere read. Pin on the loop: OK. Not waterfront stands.
flags: Count and hookups unstated: neither the city page nor the go2gov landing page gives a site count or whether pads have electric; imagery shows roughly 15-18 angled gravel pads on the loop and its south spur (an estimate, not written). Weak spot.
WATERFRONT not waterfront stands: a small creek runs in a wooded ravine north and east of the loop, 50 m+ from the nearest pads through continuous trees; no water seen from the sites.
